name: Potential Data Exfiltration Activity Via CommandLine Tools
description: Detects the use of various CLI utilities exfiltrating data via web requests
author: GAI_CTI
query: (((process.executable:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\cmd.exe)) AND (process.command_line:(*Invoke\-WebRequest* OR *iwr\ * OR *wget\ * OR *curl\ *)) AND (process.command_line:*\ \-ur* AND process.command_line:*\ \-me* AND process.command_line:*\ \-b* AND process.command_line:*\ POST\ *)) OR ((process.executable:*\\curl.exe AND process.command_line:*\-\-ur*) AND (process.command_line:(*\ \-d\ * OR *\ \-\-data\ *))) OR (process.executable:*\\wget.exe AND (process.command_line:(*\-\-post\-data* OR *\-\-post\-file*)))) AND ((process.command_line:(*Get\-Content* OR *GetBytes* OR *hostname* OR *ifconfig* OR *ipconfig* OR *net\ view* OR *netstat* OR *nltest* OR *qprocess* OR *sc\ query* OR *systeminfo* OR *tasklist* OR *ToBase64String* OR *whoami*)) OR (process.command_line:*type\ * AND process.command_line:*\ \>\ * AND process.command_line:*\ C\:\\*))
